- **#768 2026-08-21 exhaustive MCP, native WebGPU, packaging, and gameplay verification.** Development: Complete for the current provider-neutral editor surface. MCP live testing: Complete. Editor/UI testing: Complete. Current source generation exposes 1,721 unique Editor endpoints plus server-owned `execute_batch`, producing 1,722 strict client-visible tools across 50 families and 21 permanent tabs. `audit-semantic-live-coverage.mjs --require-complete` proves 1,722/1,722 positive valid-state tool calls across 82 real-editor scenarios; error-only probes and the exhaustive dispatch guard do not count. Contract, manifest, inventory, closed-schema, annotations, and unknown-field gates pass. The whole-editor physical audit passes all 21 workspaces. Complete clean suites pass 1,049 Tools tests and 1,992 Editor tests; CLI passes 60 tests with one documented platform skip. Codex CLI 0.144.5 called the live configured server and returned the exact current project/scene; Claude Code 2.1.220 discovers the same server and schema but its model invocation remains externally blocked by the machine's expired Anthropic OAuth session. Native Chrome/Metal WebGPU passes real compute dispatch, MRT attachments, four output readbacks, render-graph conformance, and isolated timestamp-query profiling; this supersedes the old hardware-unverified notes in #299–#311. A clean unsigned ARM64 package completed in 399 seconds, producing a branded `Zvibe Editor 1.0.0` app, ZIP, and DMG with matching bundle metadata. The rebuilt production Neon Apex game gate targets the served game rather than the Editor canvas and passes physical throttle to 331 km/h, HUD/lap/position/time, CAM/REAR/RESET, reset to 0 km/h, visible car/track, and zero game/editor runtime errors. This audit fixed explicit node-owned resource disposal, cancellable thumbnail generation, imported-texture readiness, imported-material texture rebasing across editor/CLI, and a real authenticated collaboration relay handshake. **This supersedes #767's former direct-live coverage gap. External platform-holder SDKs/devkits/certification, vendor signing credentials/services, physical mobile/XR devices, and the expired Claude account are environment/credential gates rather than locally implementable MCP omissions.**

- **#767 2026-08-16 game, Editor, and MCP end-to-end verification.** Domain completion: Complete. Contract completion: Complete. Whole-editor UI testing: Complete. The Neon Apex game was manually driven through all five laps and its steering, throttle, brake/drift, double-Shift nitro/shockwave, takedown, camera, rear view, mute, and reset workflows were verified; the final production Next build and a restarted production server now load lap `1/5` with responsive CAM/REAR/MUTE/RESET controls and no browser errors. The independent physical Electron audit passes all 21 permanent tabs with pointer/keyboard input, real Play/profiler/host state transitions, exact cleanup, and no retained error boundary or unexpected renderer exception. The strict generated contract passes 1,716 client tools, 1,715 Editor endpoints plus server-owned `execute_batch`, 50 families, 21 tabs, closed schemas, annotations, and unknown-field rejection; the complete Editor suite passes 315 files / 1,976 tests. This verification found and fixed five sequencing defects: unbounded script-export metadata reads, stale Inspector worker extraction after script deletion, unnecessary full asset-watcher rebuilds for unrelated Project Settings, stale Animation Window group names after scene disposal, and disposable Script Debugger/public build artifact cleanup. The generated feature inventory and cleanup replay pass.

    The stricter static direct-live audit is not complete: 874/1,716 tools (50.93%) are explicitly named by one of the 54 live artifacts (53 domain scenarios plus the whole-editor audit), leaving 842 tools without direct scenario-name coverage. Of those, 788 also lack an exact tool-name mention in test source. This is a coverage-evidence gap, not proof that those tools are broken; contract validation, complete unit/integration suites, domain lifecycles, shared owners, and permanent UI tests cover many indirectly. Consequently, **“every MCP tool and every function has been individually live-tested” is not yet a valid claim.** `mcp/scripts/audit-live-coverage.mjs` is the authoritative reproducible gap report. Next testing work is to add direct, stateful lifecycle cases for the uncovered registration modules, led by rendering (110), project (89), assets (70), rigging (54), prefabs (45), particles (44), animator/materials (36 each), navmesh (33), lights (29), input (28), meshes (27), sounds (25), scene (24), and animations (22), rerunning each addition against the real editor before reducing this row.
